newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen continuing upward movement.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen continuing upward movement.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks on Monday were expected to extend last week's gains on anticipation of improved second half corporate results, brokers said.
They said selected buying in blue chips and retailer interest in second tier stocks were likely to push the market higher.
"There is lot of buying in second rung stocks. We also expect some profit-taking by retailers. But overall, the market should move up," said Sarinda Unamboowe of John Keells stocks brokers.
"Overall market sentiment is positive," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.
Sri Lanka stocks closed 10.8 points higher at 787.4 on Thursday, the last trading day, on widespread local and foreign buying of blue chips.
The stock market was closed on Friday for a Buddhist religious holiday.
